title: Diagonal subsequence with closed-set limsup bounds on every ball B̄_R(0)
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ and let μ_j (j ∈ ℕ) be measures on ℝ^P = Eucl P with sup_j μ_j(ℝ^P) < ∞. Then there are a strictly increasing φ : ℕ → ℕ and measures ν_R (R ∈ ℕ) on ℝ^P, with ν_R(ℝ^P) < ∞ for every R, such that for every R ∈ ℕ and every closed set F ⊆ ℝ^P with F ⊆ B̄_R(0) = closedBall 0 R: limsup_{j→∞} μ_{φ(j)}(F) ≤ ν_R(F).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : ℕ → Measure (Eucl P)), (⨆ j, μ j univ) < ∞ → ∃ (φ : ℕ → ℕ) (ν : ℕ → Measure (Eucl P)), StrictMono φ ∧ (∀ R, ν R univ < ∞) ∧ ∀ (R : ℕ) (F : Set (Eucl P)), IsClosed F → F ⊆ closedBall 0 (R : ℝ) → limsup (fun j => μ (φ j) F) atTop ≤ ν R F
